entities.name: António Diniz da Cruz e Silva
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: António Diniz da Cruz e Silva was a Portuguese magistrate and heroic-comic poet, son of a Lisbon carpenter who emigrated to the Portuguese colony of Brazil shortly before the poet's birth, leaving his wife to support and educate her young family by the earnings of her needle.
